sentences.text: Prosecutrix is a major and was consenting party.
She went along with the applicant to different places and did not make hue and cry for help nor resist.
Prosecutrix was married to applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that applicant is relative of prosecutrix and has forcibly taken her and committed rape on her.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix went to different places along with the applicant and did not raise hue and cry for help.
It cannot be said that prosecutrix is minor.
At this stage, applicant is disputing the fact that prosecutrix is minor.
In ossification test, her age is mentioned between 15-16 1/2 years.
6 . Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

8. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
